Outcome_variable.evidence_source: Regarding satisfaction with life, the mean intercepts of the achievement, carefree diffusion, and moratorium-to-achievement trajectories exceeded those of the troubled diffusion and troubled diffusion-to-moratorium trajectories. Furthermore, the mean slopes of the transitional identity trajectories (i.e., troubled diffusion-to-moratorium and moratorium-to-achievement) exceeded those of the stable identity trajectories (i.e., achievement, carefree diffusion, and troubled diffusion). Regarding mean intercepts for subjective happiness, the achievement class scored highest, and the carefree diffusion and moratorium-to-achievement trajectories exceeded the troubled diffusion and the troubled diffusion-to-moratorium trajectories. Finally, mean slopes in the moratorium-to-achievement trajectory tended to increase over time.
Outcome_variable.warning: The paper also mentions 'Subjective happiness', but this is not one of the allowed categories ('life satisfaction', 'positive affect', 'negative affect').
